scope: Revised fourth-family header mana only. Existing frame/font assets and frozen family registration. Rules symbols, title width and all other components remain unchanged. Selection covers color glyphs, bare numbers/X, repeated colors, long rows and two-digit costs. No per-scan placement.
reservation: These cards have appeared in earlier body/lettering work; reserve their mana crops for this study, not first-ever exposure. Candidate committed before reserved costs are inspected.

gate: Require correct printed glyph identity and disc presence; no unrelated pixels or input changes; median cost-row dark-ink F1 must improve at both tiers, with no unexplained individual regression >.02. Keep NCC/Census and per-symbol values as separate diagnostics. Inspect every reserved crop. Any failed transfer remains rejected; no refitting on those cards.
candidateDesign: Inspect development crops before choosing the bounded grid. Positions must share right edge, pitch, top and size. A historical glyph mapping is shared by symbol, never card name. Missing historical glyphs remain asset-backlog items.
